text: Gali 4 mein gas distribution line mein pani dakhil ho gaya hai, pressure zero hai.

pichlay haftay se barish ke baad Orangi Town public school ke paas do foot paani khara hai drainage nala kaam nahi kar raha, aur is ke sath sath alag se is ke qareeb par kisi ne khudai ki aur gas ki pipeline phat gai hai.
